text:
emma: Heads-up: design partner intake for the private + dedicated beta. Need to finalize recruitment copy, acceptance gates, and a minimum feedback bundle by Friday. Goal: 8 partners, 2-week engagement, measurable perf + quality signals.

noah: Suggest we require a simple integration test (3 canonical prompts) and a signed scope sheet. Keeps expectations aligned; prevents feature requests like custom kernels.

li: Agree on the 3 prompt hook. Also propose a "no deep custom ops" clause and a clear list of tunable params we will accept (temp, top_p, batch_size within limits).

marta: For incentives: small stipend + credits (e.g., $400 + $1.5k infra credit). Also offer a 1:1 post-beta tuning call and a short performance summary tailored to their workloads. That helps retention.

emma: Love the retention angle. Can we define success criteria now? My draft: 1) 6/8 partners complete feedback form, 2) median embedding sim to baseline >= 0.9 on canonical prompts, 3) 95th-pctl latency <= 300ms on our dedicated rig, 4) at least 1 actionable product improvement.

noah: Add a quality safeguard: no partner-reported critical regressions (P0) vs their baseline. If a block appears, we pause onboarding for the cohort.

li: Technical bits: I'll add a small tracing flag to provide per-request redacted traces and token counts. Partners must opt-in to share redacted traces. We'll display metrics on a per-partner dashboard.

marta: Feedback flow: week1 onboarding + quick survey, week2 structured interview + final form. Keep forms <8 questions. Offer calendar times for interviews.

emma: Draft invite blurb suggestion: 
```
Join our 2-week private beta (8 seats). We'll provide $400 + infra credit, 30-60m onboarding, and simple eval hooks (3 prompts + a short form). Participation requires a single POC and opt-in to share redacted traces for diagnostics. We do not support custom quantizations or kernel changes during the beta.
```

noah: Minor edit: call out "no guaranteed hotfix SLA" for non-P0 issues to set expectations.

li: Measurement plan: partners run the 3 prompts at onboarding and again at end of week2. We'll compute embedding similarity + diff in human acceptability (1-5). Also capture latency distribution and token counts.

marta: Win conditions for announcing success: onboard >=6 partners AND we can show a measurable tuning action taken (e.g., batching tweak, cache policy) that reduces 95th-pctl latency by >10% in our test harness.

emma: Action list: Li -> implement tracing flag + dashboard widgets, Noah -> update invite copy with legal + SLA language, Marta -> finalize stipend/credits and schedule interview slots, Emma -> assemble canonical prompts and the short form. Ops: devops-bot, check send quota for bulk invites.

devops-bot: Reminder: bulk invites capped at 450/hr. Please stagger sends to avoid rate limits. :robot_face:

noah: I'll post the edited invite in #product-review by tomorrow morning. Quick win: can someone sanity-check the 3 prompts for coverage?
